name: @xrpl-utilities/mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for the XRPL-Utilities portfolio: Sentinel (wallet classifier), Pulse (signal feed), Telemetry (supply + utility floor), Trust (XLS-70/80/81 directory), Vault (RWA tracker), and Flows (ETF AUM ↔ XRPL flow correlation). Exposes each service's read endpoints as MCP tools so AI agents can discover and use them via stdio (Claude Desktop) or HTTP/SSE (hosted at mcp.xrpl-utilities.io). Stateless passthrough — caller provides their own x402 payment header.
